# Urania Studio

> Urania Studio is a cultural hub and production studio in Cluj-Napoca, Romania (Strada Horea nr. 4). It rents a stage hall / blackbox, a sound studio and a rehearsal room for rehearsals, concerts, shows, conferences, workshops, podcasts, photo and video production.

Site language: Romanian. Contact: uraniastudio.eu@gmail.com, +40 756 861 229.

## Pages

- [Home](https://uraniastudio.eu/): overview of the venue, upcoming events and prices
- [Spații (Spaces)](https://uraniastudio.eu/spatii.php): the three rooms — main stage hall (blackbox), sound studio, rehearsal room
- [Prețuri (Prices)](https://uraniastudio.eu/preturi.php): rates for rehearsals, podcast/photo/video, conferences and workshops, shows and concerts; custom quote form
- [Jurnal (Events)](https://uraniastudio.eu/jurnal.php): past and upcoming events at Urania
- [Contact](https://uraniastudio.eu/contact.php): booking requests, address and contact details
